files.note: Source selector: Docker → OpenShift → OpenShift Loki — Not available (disabled option).
Search narrowed to API_LOGS before any rule exists: Tags column present, every row "—".
Unclassified event: only "Create tag rule from this event" is offered.
Rule builder, Source step: the anchor field and the selected event's value.
Detect step before running: what the sample will be read from.
Detect result on the CURRENT search population (PR #60): sampled/similar counts, stable structure, variable parts, suggested pattern and suggested extractions.
Classification step: name, tags and the Tag colour palette with a live preview chip.
Extraction step: values adopted from the detector, and the suggestion panel reporting what it read and what is already extracted.
Assisted extraction: suggestions measured on the matching events (Found in n / m), each with an output name, sensitivity and Remove.
Test results against the current-search sample: matched / not matched, extraction coverage, matched and borderline examples, review note.
Save step: the review summary before an explicit save.
Saved: truthful guidance that already-loaded results are not silently mutated.
PR #60 core outcome: the Tags column is visible by default and matching rows carry the tag in the rule colour — no inspector needed.
Two rules match: the first tag chip plus "+1", with the full list in the accessible name and tooltip.
Tag filter in More filters: ANY selected tag, applied server-side after classification.
Classified event: "Add extraction from this event" and "Create another tag rule" — two distinct actions.
Inspector Classification: tag identity in the same colour as the table, one block per matching rule, extracted values.
Add extraction from this event, several matching rules: the user chooses which rule to extend — never an ambiguous default.
The chosen rule opens on its extraction step, with the event as the anchor for suggestions.
Settings › Classification rules: each rule with its tags drawn in its own colour, matcher summary, extract count, enabled switch and actions.
Import preview of a pack whose rule gives an existing tag a different colour — the conflict is reported before anything is written.
